pattern_explanation: These Turkish words were borrowed from French, and their English look-alikes came from the same French source, but over time the meanings drifted apart in each language, so the forms stayed close while the meanings separated.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish words transliterated as pasaj, eventuel, pratik and lokal look close to the English words passage, eventual, practical and local, but they mean arcade, possible, convenient and bar, so a learner who trusts the similar form will choose the wrong meaning.
